column1: // Constructions of the rewrite layer (docs/rule-language.md, 구문 표): the Korean of a word picked
// from the words around it, after the word stage has chosen every candidate.
// A family is declared once by "//= FAMILY <TAB> after NAME <TAB> what it is for" and runs right
// after the text pass or family NAME. Its rows are ID <TAB> SPEC <TAB> CONDITION <TAB> ACTIONS
// <TAB> NOTE, ID being cx:FAMILY:PRIO. On each word from the left, the first row of the family by
// PRIO whose condition holds applies its actions.

column3: The ほど or 程 of degree read in 수록 or 만큼 is 정도, and the に after it (으)로, unless a ば condition stands before it.

column5: 痛ましい程に 참혹할 정도로
ほどに with に its own word

column3: The に of a purpose read 하러 before 戻る is the place one goes back to.

column5: 仕事に戻った 일로 돌아왔다

column3: The から read (으)로부터 is 부터 after a time or a number, and 에서 after a place or scene.
&&5 S+0== "Lから" F+0== "selected" D+0== "L(으)로부터" ||2 F+0== "last" &&2 S+1!= "が" S+1!= @Lword.kara-source-keep ||4 H+0== @Rnoun.time-end F+0== "after-digit" H+0== "R番" H+0== "R号"

&&8 S+0== "Lから" F+0== "selected" D+0== "L(으)로부터" ||2 F+0== "last" &&2 S+1!= "が" S+1!= @Lword.kara-source-keep F-1== "selected" F-1!= "conjugating" P-1== "1" ||3 A-1== "VPl" A-1== "VBp" S-1== @noun.scene
The に read 에 is (으)로 after くらい, and nothing after a て form that goes on or after an adverb-like noun.
&&5 S+0== "に" F+0== "selected" F-1== "selected" L+0== "에" ||2 S-1== "くらい" S-1== "ぐらい"
